boundary: Fresh lightweight setup and operation. Expanded-key import, caller copies, keygen encoding, output checks, negative checks, and ownership checks excluded. No persistent key/matrix cache.
screen_promotion_rule: Exploratory candidate for confirmation only if a cell improves aggregate wall and calling-thread CPU by at least 3%, all four wall rounds improve, and no other cell has both aggregate wall regression above 3% and all four wall rounds slower. Preserve every smaller loss and all allocations; no significance or universal win is established.
